Container.Name: pretix
Container.Overview: Throwaway test instance of pretix (event ticketing) using its official standalone image with a built-in SQLite database - no Postgres/Redis containers involved, nothing touches ports used by other services on this NAS. Not intended for production or long-term data: for real use, follow pretix's official docker-compose stack with Postgres+Redis instead.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the pretix web UI. Only this port is exposed to the host - no internal Postgres/Redis ports are published, so this cannot collide with existing Postgres/Redis instances on this NAS.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data: SQLite database, uploaded media, logs. Delete this folder to fully reset the test instance.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: pretix.cfg file (SQLite backend, no external DB/Redis). Create this file on the host before starting the container - see the pretix.cfg content provided alongside this template.
